name: Controls posture
description: Every application's standing on six security controls, a day at a time (ADR 0013): each control arrives as its own file, is checked on its own, and the posture across them is judged as a dataset of its own, so what two controls do together is found without a rule naming them. A synthetic feed, generated from a fixed seed (scripts/data/controls.ts), with one trouble a day planted in March 2024: data missing (Wed 6), a column missing (Mon 11), a value never seen (Thu 14), two columns of one control off together (Tue 19), and two controls off together (Fri 22).

sources.description: The application inventory: unit, environment and tier
Transport encryption: the protocol its hosts offer and the certificate's days left
Encryption of data at rest, and whether its keys are managed
Multi-factor authentication enforced for the application's users
Open critical and high vulnerabilities against the patching SLA
Logs shipped to the central sink, and how much of the application they cover
Backups taken on time, and restores tested
